## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the preview’s directory check before merge. It lets callers read files outside the selected home directory.

## Changes

The pull request adds a helper that returns up to 200 characters from a file under the selected home directory and a helper that builds the path to `settings.toml`. It adds tests for short and long previews, rejection of an outside absolute path, and the settings path.

## Critical

- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Check the resolved path before previewing — A relative path that uses `..` to reach a readable sibling file, or an in-home symlink to a readable outside file, passes `is_relative_to()` because it checks path components without resolving them. — A caller can read the first 200 characters of a file outside the selected home directory. — Fix: Resolve both the home and candidate before checking containment, then read the resolved candidate.

## Important

- app/paths.py:14 — correctness — Read only the requested preview length — Previewing a multi-gigabyte text log loads the entire file because `read_text()` completes before `[:200]` limits the result. — A log larger than available memory can exhaust the process’s memory before the caller gets a preview. — Fix: Open the file as a text stream and read at most 200 characters.
